question: India is a parliamentary democracy based on the Westminster model of _______.
solution: The correct answer is __**the United Kingdom.**__ __** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__** • **Westminster Model:-** • **It is a system of parliamentary government that originated in the United Kingdom.** • **India is a parliamentary democracy based on the Westminster model of government.** • It is characterized by the following features: • A head of state who is a constitutional monarch or president, with largely ceremonial powers. • A head of government, usually the prime minister, who is the leader of the political party or coalition with the majority of seats in the lower house of parliament. • A cabinet of ministers who are appointed by the prime minister and are responsible to parliament. • A bicameral parliament, consisting of a lower house and an upper house. • A strong tradition of parliamentary sovereignty, meaning that parliament is the supreme lawmaking body.
